verdict.rationale: The pack has no evidence of an interactive API reference with runnable examples for Okta's APIs. The XAA playground (okta-docs-6/12) lets users explore one protocol flow end-to-end, but it is a feature demo, not an API reference. The rate-limits reference page is static documentation, and the probes found no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path, which offers no sign of a machine-readable or try-it API explorer.
